item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 27 #NLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 27 FINAL #NLPRSD
Issued at 06:05 AM 15 September 2026

All Thunderstorm Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated. However, all are still advised to continue monitoring for updates.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards. Residents along mountain slope are advised for possible landslides mudslides, rockslides and flash flood.

Keep monitoring for updates.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Isabela(Palanan), #Quirino(Nagtipunan, Cabarroguis, Saguday, Diffun), #NuevaVizcaya(Kasibu), #Aurora(SanLuis, Dingalan, Baler, Dipaculao), #IlocosNorte(Pasuquin, Burgos, Vintar, Bangui, Adams, Pagudpud, Dumalneg), #Apayao(Calanasan), #Cagayan(Pamplona, SanchezMira, Claveria, SantaPraxedes and Calayan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

Keep monitoring for updates.
